text: さすがに　コイキング　じゃ　ダメか

patterns.name: 〜ではだめだ
patterns.span: コイキング　じゃ　ダメ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the spoken short form of では, 'if it's this, using this'; with ダメ it says that thing is not good enough. コイキング　じゃ　ダメ = 'Magikarp won't do'

patterns.name: 〜か (realizing)
patterns.explanation: か said in a falling tone to yourself is not a real question; it shows you have just accepted something. ダメか = 'so it's no good, huh'
